prompt: The API returns invoices in snake_case with amount_cents, but the UI/export layer expects amountCents. Fix normalizeInvoice so it translates the API shape into the internal shape at this boundary, for both single invoices and lists.
expected_failure_summary: normalizeInvoice passes the raw API shape through, leaving amount_cents and never producing amountCents.
task_author_notes: Correct fix maps amount_cents -> amountCents at the boundary and does not leak the raw key. Reject one-off patches that only add amountCents while keeping amount_cents.
